== Summary ==
[[Tamás Papp]], [[Kevin Jaap]] and [[Chris Menzel]] laughing during the presentation; the trophy engraved "Kevin Jaap" stands on the table.

* '''Event:''' [[2024 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2024-09-21
* '''Camera date:''' 2024-09-21 (Day 1; posted that evening)
* '''Identification:''' [[Tamás Papp]]: face match with his [[:File:Tamas Papp (community card).jpg|community card]], and he was the tournament director, here working the organizers' desk in the same blue T-shirt all day; [[Kevin Jaap]]: face match with his [[:File:Kevin Jaap 2024 Hall of Fame.jpg|Hall of Fame photo]], where he wears the same white polo; [[Chris Menzel]]: his name and "Hall of Fame" are embroidered on his shirt, and the wrap-up says he presented Kevin Jaap's Hall of Fame award; the trophy on the table is engraved with Jaap's name.

== Source ==
Posted in the #2024-worlds-bochum channel of the Players Committee Slack (starwarsccg.slack.com), 2024-09-21. Original file name: 1000006026.jpg (4032×2268); Slack file id F07ND9PPASH.
* '''Photographer / posted by:''' [[Scott Lingrell]] (Slack: Scott)
